Words, they come out from the mouths of every human that has the ability to speak. They come in form of languages, there are many languages, and many words mean more than just one thing. Words may be used as tools, as weapons, some may even go as far as to say that words are power. Some say words are the lingual physical form of human emotions and so on. We all have some sort of idea what words are and as common as the word “word” may sound, it holds much importance. As tools, weapons, human emotions, or power in itself may be linked to words, people have often written many quotes about what words can do and have done. The quotes, also words themselves, have changed many schools of thoughts when presented with insist. Among this, the most famous one would be, “Once said, it cannot be taken back.” That is, words are irreversible. This factor is probably the reason why some people assigned the element of power to words. Power induces the balance of good, the evil and the neutral. This concept enlarges the battleground for any given though or thing of existence. That means, the world of words is a big battleground, full of all sorts of intentions.

I sat in the alley that led to my room, staring at the wall right in front of me with dead eyes, my body shivering. What had happened in these couple of minutes? It was nothing supernatural that hadn’t happened before in this world, but it totally felt like that. The palms of my hands were red with blood which was not mine. The white marble floor was covered in lined of red too, with my wife’s body just a couple of feet to me. My life had taken a turn, and it totally felt as if I was the one that lead it on. The nearing police sirens increased my sense of guilt. “Why, …” my mind and heart kept asking me, “why did I say that?” I turned to look at my wife, she laid with her back upwards, shot in the head, eyes opened, dressed in her night suit, a pink pajama and shirt. I was unable to protect her. The proof was the expression of terror frozen on her dead face. It was the last expression she would ever give.

*3 hours and 47 Minutes ago*

“You should sleep darling, it’s already midnight. Switch that light off too, why would you read the book at this hour of the day anyways?” I said to my wife in a soft tone as the light made it unable for me to sleep. She looked at me, gave me a worried glance. “What’s wrong Angie?” It made me ask her impulsively. “It’s… it’s just that I seem to keep having these bad dreams as of lately. Sort of makes me feel uncomfortable wanting to go to sleep.” Her tone was confused; she was looking at me for support. I sat back on the bed and got a bit closer to her, facing her now I caressed her face. She held my hand with her cheek by her own hands and closed her eyes as if to take in the moment, I couldn’t help but say “I won’t let anything happen to you as long as I am besides you. Don’t worry, now let’s sleep, I am with you.” I held her hand in mine and laid back. She switched the lamp off as well and snuggled close to me. I could feel she felt better with me. It was comforting. We both had our eyes closed and eventually went to sleep.

*3 hours later*

It was the sudden sound of glass cracking and shrieking that brought us back to wake from our slumber. Angie’s hand was still within mind, she too was shocked and scared due to the sound. The sudden wake had both our hearts beating fast. I held her more tightly and told her to calm down, it also calmed me down having her near me. She looked pretty terrified, but was calming down as I patted her back. “Let me go check, you stay put.” I told her. She clenched her fist on my shirt. I held her hand, and she slowly loosened her grip. I was looking into her eyes; I had assured her once again that it is alright. I stood up, went to the closet, and in the lowest section, where there were couple of shoes and boxes, I fetched a white box in the middle, opened it, took out a firearm from it. I looked at my wife again, she looked scared seeing that thing within my hands. I showed her a gesture that it is just a precaution and headed towards the door. Slowly, without making a sound, I made my way out to the room, it was dark and silent outside. I moved out towards the kitchen from where the sound seemed to have originated. Something must have fallen I thought to myself. During all this, it was dark, and as I proceeded, BANG!! I felt something hit me at the back of my head. My senses went numb, And the next moment I knew. I had fallen down.

It took me some more than thirty minutes to have my eyes open again. My head was all dizzy. I woke up, and stood, it was all hazy in my mind. I went towards the switch, turned the lights on, and the exact moment, I saw my wife’s corpse laying in the alley, seemingly being dragged from the room given the stains, she was shot in the head. I looked here and there, my gun was missing. And within a couple of minutes, my rationale came back. My head started working again, but by then, the sudden shock of my wife’s death had already gone. She was dead. I walked silently towards her, sat down, held her hand. It was the last time I would be feeling her warmth. I was not feeling much. It was as if I had a hole within my body, a big hole, stopping me from thinking and feeling much, I sat and few tears spilled down. My whole self-did not appeared to be in order. It was as if there was a latency lag between me and the rest of the world with passing time. I crawled a bit further, took to the wall with my back for support, and took to the wall in front of me to see, what was left of me. The blank expression the wall was giving explained best of me at that time. Moments later I could hear sirens. The police were probably arriving. “I won’t let anything happen to you as long as I am besides you.” The words echoed within my head again and again as I stared the dead face of my wife, her hand in mine, the hand which had now gone cold.

*3 years later*

“Please send in Mr.Jacob.” The man spoke in the phone as he put it down. It was a decent office. A few minute later, I entered the office as called by the man who was my boss. “Mr.Jocob, we have a few files that were left unchecked during our project Airwave Parking’s. Please go through them and confirm if all is still good, we don’t want trouble sprouting later on.” He said to me while handing me the files. I lent my hand forward to take those files while looking him in the eyes. “Mr.Jacob, you need to affirm me that you have understood and are up for the task. Because if you are not up to it I can always assign someone else. You need to at least try to convince me in such situations. It is for your own good too.” “Sir, I would, but there is no guarantee in life. Words, they hit back at you. They are powerful sir; I tell you that. I don’t want another battle against my own words, for sir, we are the weakest, when we face our weaknesses.” The man stepped up from his chair, he walked towards me, and while keeping his hand on my shoulder, I heard him say, “Jacob, you are a talented individual, I cannot see you go down like that. Words, you say right? Jacob, words define what we want to say, and we want to want to say also defines us, won’t you agree?” He looked at me as if waiting for a response, I stared at him plainly, tried my best to give him a nod. “If you are fearful of what you say, I really don’t know what happened to you (he spoke frantically), but if you are fearful, that fear will soon ooze down to you, corrupt you, chain you, like you are chained right now. Something that doesn’t come, when your words acclaimed it would doesn’t make you a failure, It simply….” “Means you did not mean them.” I cut his sentence and looked at him deeply in the eye. I’m sure, they were saying to him, ‘Thank you for trying to help, but, it is already late.’ The boss stared at me, then took the files from hand gently. He went to his desk, took a card, put it in my pocket on my shirt, “You can leave now.” And so, I Left.

The card I once received from my boss was of a certain psychologist. One day I did visit him. He talked to me twice later on, then referred me to someone else, it has been 2 month I have been going to see this psychologist. Honestly, it feels relaxing and relieving. And just like any other day, today too I was scheduled to meet him. She said something about having a viable thing to talk about today.

“Talking about the past is easy. It is already done. I am recounting mere incidents with words. The words I use are lifeless. They cannot change what has already happened. I was sad, does not make me sad now. Now is another world, it is a world where the words can come back at you.” I told Miss Chelsea. “Mr. Jacob, put it blunt, you have suffered severe trauma, it could be due to a head injury when you were attacked 3 years ago, also followed by the shock of your wife’s sudden death. And now, you are just looking for excuses to dump on to. It may sound harsh, but what you are afraid of is not words, but accepting the fact that you are unable to move on.” I did not mind at all, what she just said. I just thought to myself, what if I had not said all that, ‘that’ night, will things would have been different. While thinking this, another thing Miss Chelsea would often say to me struck my mind, past surfing again, won’t make the waves of the present any smoother. They will still hit you. “What was the proposal you had for me when you talked to me on the phone?” I asked. “It may sound weird, it might even be not the best choice, but I feel like it is the one, that has the most likely hood of getting you to see, your own words, and that, they are not the chain that will liberate you.”

The ended. What she said kept reverberating in my head the whole day, I was just lost in thought. Was it really okay, will it be for the good. I kept pondering and then, I came to decision, that I would try, Just maybe. It was not an easy procedure, all the paperwork and approvals. But in a span of a month, all processing’s had been done, and there I brought, this 16-year-old boy to my house. From today, I was his legal guardian. Yes, I had adopted a child.

It was not easy to pull this through, but it happened, with the support from Miss Chelsea. I decided to stick to name he was called all in his orphanage. Sana. Some said it was a girl’s name. But, it means sound in Latin. Apparently a Spanish senior boy in his orphanage named him that, he said, that Sana, was the sound that no one could hear, it was a sound that could not be understood by ordinary means. Either the boy was a big idiot or he was just to special to hear what no one else could, because Sana, was a boy, who was dumb. He had no voice, he could not speak, and like that, I never heard him say or speak anything. I was to live with that boy starting today.

I was a person who spoke only to survive, only what was definitive. But now, things started to break, there was someone who was in an even worse situation as me, this forced me to say things I would not want to say. This was supposed to be my moving stone to go past myself. But things did not go smoothly. There was no tragedy, nothing, it was just, every time I spoke, every word I used, it used to come back to my head, it hurt. It made me uncomfortable. It was as if I would just increase the chains on my own self. It started breaking me more. I was not ready for the change that was brought upon myself.

Sana would only nod, a silent in even gestures, he felt dry and dead, as if he really had nothing to say. It was not like me, I wanted to say a lot of things, but I did not want to be haunted by them, words, they leave mouths and don’t come back, they cant be taken back after all, but my words, its like they stick to me. Words hurts even if they uttered wrong, and they hurt, even if they are not uttered. All of this made me envious of Sana.

It was a day like any other.
